description.en-US:
Paseo Assembly follows a pinned, reproducible fork-assembler stack based on
upstream Paseo plus selected topic branches.

This channel is intended for development snapshots. It uses a distinct
Android package ID, so it can be installed alongside the production Paseo
app. F-Droid builds intentionally omit QR scanning, push notifications, and
Expo over-the-air updates; direct and pasted-link pairing remain available.
